full_solids.note: Engineering adaptation of the hollow winding member and core bonding in JP2004241190A paragraph 0005, Fig.7(c,d); paragraph 0055 also permits bobbins. This is generic multipole construction evidence, not verified CEOS HP1/HP2 hardware. Rectangular former flanges, unspecified insulating material and bulk core bedding are saved reconstruction assumptions. No individual turns, screws, cooling or mounting to the column is inferred. Original copper, magnetic poles, yoke and all field inputs are unchanged. These passive solids do not add a field solve.

This is generic multipole construction evidence, not verified CEOS HP1/HP2 hardware. Rectangular former flanges, unspecified insulating material and bulk core bedding are saved reconstruction assumptions. No individual turns, screws, cooling or mounting to the column is inferred. Original copper, magnetic poles, yoke and all field inputs are unchanged. These passive solids do not add a field solve.

parameters.contact_definition: Copper-window walls and radial end faces contact the former; bulk bedding joins the former inner wall to the existing rectangular core.

full_solids.note: Optional external winding insulation jacket, explicitly engineered rather than OEM geometry. Six rectangular sleeves enclose the original radial-axis bulk copper envelope without changing its window or extending its radial ends. Original poles, yoke, winding formers, core bedding, vacuum passage and all optical/field inputs remain unchanged. Material grade, dielectric rating, turns, leads and electrical current are not inferred. This CAD subdivision does not add a magnetic-material solve or an optical excitation.

parameters.radial_extent_policy: Original copper start/end radii retained; no radial-end caps
